terminals.name: server
terminals.description: LimitlessAI API on port 3001. Reads ../.env. OPENBOT_SINGLE_USER=true admits every request as the local administrator.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd server && bun --env-file=../.env src/index.ts

terminals.name: app
terminals.description: Vite UI on port 3010, proxying /api to the server. Bound to 0.0.0.0 so Cloud Agent port forwarding can reach it.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd app && bun run dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3010 --strictPort

terminals.name: worker
terminals.description: Claims unattended jobs (Send-and-go, cron, webhook, inbound email).
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd worker && bun --env-file=../.env src/index.ts
